verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an official, documented CLI (`supabase init` and `supabase start`) for local development and migration workflows. A runtime probe confirmed it runs keylessly via `npx -y supabase --version` (2.117.0) with no account or login. Adjacent official CLI-driven agent tooling exists too: `npx skills add supabase/agent-skills` and `npx plugins add`. Missing for 10: no evidence of agent-oriented CLI ergonomics (machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive auth for agents), and only thin coverage of the full command surface beyond init/start and migrations.
